source_caption_text:
This might genuinely be his best verse ever

Blueface may have peaked with his verse on “Outside (Better Days)” in 2021. Known for his unconventional flow, he completely switched things up and delivered a focused, emotional performance that caught fans off guard.

His delivery stays locked into the beat while he reflects on loss, struggle, and the experiences that shaped him. The contrast between his usual style and the vulnerable tone of the verse makes it stand out even more.

For many fans, this remains one of Blueface’s strongest performances. “Outside (Better Days)” showed a different side of his artistry and proved he could deliver when the moment called for it.
